hud.hint: Move: WASD or arrows. Attack: left mouse button toward the cursor, or Space for the nearest monster. Skills: Q, E, R (learn them from the trainer in the village). Potions: 1 and 2. Weapon charges on or off: F. T: talk to the person next to you, or enter a glowing doorway. Right mouse button: walk to a spot. I: inventory. Walk over loot to pick it up. The world is open: leave the village through the east gate and follow the road.
skillInfo.heavyBlow: A narrow, far-reaching strike toward the cursor that deals more than double damage.
skillInfo.sweep: A strike that hits every monster around you.
skillInfo.secondWind: Restores about a third of your health at once.
